verses.text: የኬልቅዩ ልጅ የአሳድዩ ልጅ የሴዴቅያስ ልጅ የማሴው ልጅ የኔርዩ ልጅ ባሮክ ወደ ባቢሎን የጻፈው ነገር ይህ ነው፤
በአምስተኛው ዓመት ከወሩ በሰባተኛው ቀን ከለዳውያን ኢየሩሳሌምን በያዙአትና በእሳት በአቃጠሏት ጊዜ፥
ባሮክ ይህን መጽሐፍ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮአቄም ልጅ በኢኮንያን ጆሮና መጽሐፉን ለመስማት ከሕዝቡ ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ በመጣው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጆሮ፥
በኀያላኑና በልዑላኑ ጆሮ፥ በሽማግሌዎች ጆሮና ከታላቁ ጀምሮ እስከ ታናሹ ድረስ በባቢሎን በሶዲ ወንዝ አጠገብ በሚኖሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጆሮ አነበበ።
እነርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አለቀሱ፤ ጾሙ፤ ጸለዩም።
እያንዳንዳቸውም እንደ እየችሎታቸው ገንዘብ ሰበሰቡ፤
እርሱንም ወደ ሰሉም ልጅ ወደ ኬልቅያ ልጅ ወደ ካህኑ ኢዮአቄም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ነበሩት ካህናትና ወደ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ላኩት።
ከቤተ መቅደስ የተወሰደውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ወደ ይሁዳ ምድር ይመልሱ ዘንድ በሲባን ወር በዐሥረኛው ቀን በወሰዱ ጊዜ ይህም ዕቃ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ ያሠራው የብር ዕቃ ነበር።
ይኸውም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ኢኮንያንንና መኳንንቱን፥ ምርኮኞቹንና ኀያላኑን የሀገሩንም ሕዝብ ይዞ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ከወሰዳቸው በኋላ ነበር።

Thus they said, "Behold, we send you money; and with it, the offerings of the burnt sacrifices and the sin offerings; and also prepare the grain offering; and bring it to the house of our God, to the Lord."
Their time shall be upon the earth as the time of heaven; therefore, pray for the king of Babylon, for Nabuchadnezzar, his life, and for his son, for Belshazzar's life.

And may the Lord grant us strength, and may He enlighten our eyes, that we may live under the shadow of the king of Babylon, under the shadow of Nabuchadnezzar, and under the shadow of his son, Belshazzar, that we may dwell in life for many days, and that we may find favor before them; pray for us.
We have sinned against our God; and the appointed time of the Lord has not returned to us until this day, and we have not turned back to our God; therefore, pray for us to our God, to the Lord.
And to you, we send this letter; read it to yourselves; on the day of the feast and on the chosen day, gather in the house of the Lord.
"Thus shall ye say: Righteousness is before our God, the Lord; but for us, it is a matter of shame; this day is for the people of Judah and for those who dwell in Jerusalem."
"For our kings and our princes, for our priests and our prophets, and for our fathers, it is as if we have been brought low."
"Before our God, the Lord, we have become guilty;"
"We have not heeded His commands, nor have we listened to the word of our God, the Lord; and we have not walked in the commandments given to us by our God, the Lord."
"From the time our fathers were brought out of the land of Egypt until this day, we have not heeded our God, the Lord; and we have not listened to His word, being far from Him."

"And the land that thou dost give us, as thou didst give to our fathers when they were brought out of the land of Egypt, O Lord, this is an evil thing and a great calamity that has come upon us even to this day."
"And as He sent to us as He did to the prophets, we have not listened to the word of our God, the Lord."
"Before our God, the Lord, we have done evil, and we have been led astray by our wicked hearts, each one of us following the desires of our evil hearts."
"Our God has spoken concerning us and concerning Israel, upon our rulers, and upon our leaders, and upon our judges, and concerning all of Judah and Israel, let His word be fulfilled."
"As it is written in the law of Moses, let there not be brought upon us any evil thing from heaven or upon Jerusalem, as it has been done, let His word be fulfilled."
"In those days, a man devoured the flesh of the sons of men and the flesh of the daughters of women."
"The Lord made them a cause for downfall and for calamity, among the nations that are around us, and He gave them into the hands of all the kings that are around us."
"Let us be as those who have not been honored; for we have not honored the word, and we have offended our God, the Lord."
"Righteousness belongs to our God, to the Lord; but for us and for our fathers, it is as today, a day of great shame."
"All the evil that has come upon us, the Lord has spoken against us."
"Let each of us return from the evil of our hearts, and let us not be ashamed before our God, the Lord."
"And the Lord has brought calamity upon us; He has brought it upon us; for all the work that the Lord has done among us is righteous."
"Before us, we have not listened to the command of the Lord, and we have not heeded His word."

"Now also, by Your mighty hand, by Your power and by Your wondrous works; You brought Your people out of the land of Egypt, and even today, as it was, You have made for Yourself a great name, O God of Israel!"
"We have committed sin; we have done evil; O Lord our God! We have acted in ways that are not fitting according to Your ordinances."
"Turn away Your anger from us; for we are but a remnant among the nations, and we are few in number."
"O Lord! Hear our supplications and our prayers; for Your name's sake, deliver us; grant us grace before the people of the earth."
"Let all the earth know that You, O Lord our God, are indeed God; Your name has been exalted among Israel and among His people."
"O Lord, look down from Your holy dwelling; O Lord, incline Your ear to us and hear us."
"Open Your eyes and behold; O Lord, the souls of those who dwell in the grave, who are separated from their bodies, do not honor You nor give thanks to You."
"Yet, there are those who mourn and are troubled, who endure much hardship, and the eyes of the oppressed look to You; O Lord, for Your righteousness shall prevail."
"O Lord our God, before You we do not presume upon Your mercy, for like our fathers and our kings, we are not righteous."
"By the hands of Your servants, the prophets, as You have spoken, You have poured out Your wrath and Your judgments upon us."
"Thus saith the Lord: Submit yourselves to Babylon, and serve the king of Babylon; and in the land which I gave unto your fathers shall ye dwell."
"If ye will not hearken unto the word of the Lord, nor serve the king of Babylon,"

"The voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride shall cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem; and the land shall be desolate, void of its inhabitants."

"We have not hearkened unto Thy word; we have not served the king of Babylon; and as the kings of our fathers and the kings of our fathers have departed from their place, so have Thy prophets spoken through Thy mouth, and it hath come upon us."
"Behold, in the day of heat and in the night of cold, they shall be taken away; we are consumed; in the drought and in the sword, in the pestilence and in the evil death."
"Because of the sin of Israel and the sin of Judah, Thy name is called upon this house, as it is this day."
"Yet, O Lord our God! According to Thy mercy, all that Thou hast done for us, grant us forgiveness."
"Before the children of Israel, Thy law was written, as Thou didst command by the hand of Thy servant Moses, saying thus, as Thou hast spoken."
"If ye will not hearken unto My voice in truth, this multitude shall return unto you in the midst of the nations, and ye shall be reduced to a remnant."
"As they will not hearken unto me, I know them; they are a stubborn people; and in the land whither they are driven, they shall return unto their own desires."
And they shall know that I am their God, the Lord, as I have been. I shall give them a heart to know Me, and ears to hear.
And when they remember Me, the land shall give thanks to them; they shall also think upon My name.
They shall return from their wickedness and from their evil deeds; before the Lord, they shall remember the way of their fathers.
I shall bring them back to the land of their fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; they shall possess it; and I shall multiply them, and they shall not be few.
I shall establish with them an everlasting covenant, that they may be My people, and I will be their God; and from henceforth, My people Israel shall not be uprooted from the land which I gave them.
"O Lord! God of Israel, who art enthroned, behold! The soul that is afflicted, and the soul that is distressed, hath cried out unto Thee."
"O Lord! Hear us, forgive us; for we have sinned before Thee."
"Thou art the One who abideth forever, but we, indeed, shall perish forever."

"Above all, O Lord God of Israel, hear the prayers of the dead of Israel, and those who have sinned before Thee, and those who have not heeded the word of their God, hear the prayers of their children."
"We have followed after evil; we have not remembered the sins of our fathers; in this time, remember Thy hand and Thy name."
"Thou art our God, O Lord! We give thanks unto Thee."

"Therefore, we call upon Thy name, and though we are unworthy, we give thanks unto Thee, and let Thy fear dwell in our hearts. Before Thee, we have removed all the iniquities of our fathers from our hearts."
"O Lord our God! Behold, this day: as we are like the dust, all the iniquities of our fathers are for destruction, for ruin and for captivity, we are in the midst of a great affliction."
"O Israel, hear the commandment of life, and heed the counsel of wisdom."
"What is Israel? Why doth it dwell in the land of its enemies?"
Why has the land perished? Why has it been forsaken with the rulers? And why has it been cut off with those who have descended to the grave?
Have you forsaken the fountain of life?
If you walk in the way of the Lord, you shall dwell in peace forever!

Where does wisdom come from? Where does strength come from? Where do counsel and knowledge originate? Where does the ability to endure for many generations come from? Where is the light of the eyes and peace found?
Who has found the land of wisdom? Who has entered into her treasures?
Where are the leaders of the nations who have sold the wild beasts of the wilderness?
In heaven, those who play are the ones who believe in silver and gold; where are the leaders of the nations who have no restraint in gathering them?
They shall be scattered who gather silver; for their work has no examination.
The leader has gone; they have descended to the grave; concerning them, others have taken heed.
The foolish see the light; they dwell in their land; yet they do not know the way of wisdom.
They have not sought Him; they have not received Him; their children have strayed from their path.
The people of Canaan have not listened; the people of Teman have not seen.
In the land, those who seek wisdom are the children of the poor; those who desire knowledge, the merchants of Mary and Teman, do not know the way of wisdom; they have not understood its pursuit.
O Israel! How great is the house of the Lord! How spacious is its place! There is no end to it; there is no measure to it.
It is great; there is no end to it; there is no measure to the upper part.
From ancient times, their stature was long, and they were known as those who understood warfare.
The Lord did not choose these; He did not give them the way of knowledge.
They did not possess wisdom, and they perished; they perished in their folly.
Who ascended to heaven and descended? Who gathered the winds in His fists?
Who has bound the waters in a garment? Who has brought forth the red gold?
There is none who knows her way, nor does any consider her search.
He knows all things; in His wisdom, He guides us. The earth, which He created, is filled with living beings forever.
He sends forth His light; and He walks therein; as in the beginning, He calls it forth; and in fear, He shall be revered.
The stars shall shine at their appointed times; they shall rejoice in their calling.
They shall be called forth; and they shall say, "We have come." For their Creator shall shine upon them with joy.
There is none like Him; they shall declare, "He is our God."
He is the guide of all paths of wisdom; He has given it to Jacob, His beloved, and to His friend, Israel.
After this, it was revealed upon the earth; and it became as a man.
This is the book of the commandment of God, which is the law of eternity; all who keep it shall live, but those who forsake it shall die.
O Jacob! Return to your stronghold; walk in its light.
Do not give your honor to another, nor your dignity to a foreign nation.
The mercy of our God, the Lord, has been made known to us, for we are Israel, a holy people.

sections.title: The Book of Consolation for Israel

verses.text: And the nations were troubled; and Israel pondered.
For you were sold for naught; but because you have provoked the Lord, you were delivered up to your enemies.
You have stirred up your Creator to anger with your abominations before the Lord.
For your transgressions have provoked your everlasting God, and your desolations have grieved your Jerusalem.
When the time of your visitation from the Lord came, it was said: "Hear, O ye exiles of Zion; the Lord has brought us back to our strength."
The everlasting God cannot bring forth the sons of men and the daughters of women.
They were filled with joy; yet they were grieved with lamentation and sorrow.
In the multitude of my afflictions, I have found no joy; for I have strayed far from the law of the Lord.
I have not kept His commandments; and I have not returned to the path of the Lord's commandments; nor have I sought after righteousness.
Let the exiles of Zion come forth; let the everlasting God bring forth the sons of men and the daughters of women, and let them rejoice.
የማያፍርና ቋንቋው ልዩ የሆነ ሕዝብን ከሩቅ አምጥቶባቸዋልና፤ ሽማግሌውን አላከበሩምና፥ ለሕፃናቱም አልራሩምና።
የመበለትነቷንም የተወደዱ ልጆች ነጠቁ፤ ከሴቶች ልጆችዋም ለይተው ብቻዋን አስቀሩአት።
ነገር ግን እኔ ምን ረዳችኋለሁ?
ክፉ ነገርን ያመጣባችሁ እርሱ ከጠላቶቻችሁ እጆች ያወጣችኋልና።
ልጆች! መንገዳችሁን ሂዱ፤ መንገዳችሁን ሂዱ፤ እኔ የተፈታች ምድረ በዳ ሁኛለሁና።
የሰላም ልብሴን አወለቅሁ፤ የመከራዬንም ማቅ ለበስሁ፤ በዘመኔም ወደ ዘለዓለማዊው አምላክ እጮሃለሁ፤
ልጆች ተጽናኑ፤ ወደ አምላክም ጩኹ፤ ከጠላቶቻችሁ እጅና አገዛዝ ያወጣችኋል።
ከዘለዓለማዊው አምላክ ዘንድ ድኅነታችሁን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁና። ከዘለዓለማዊው መድኀኒታችን ዘንድ ፈጥኖ ስለሚመጣላችሁ ምሕረትም ደስታ ከቅዱሱ መጣልኝ፤
ከኀዘንና ከልቅሶ ጋር ሸኝቻችኋለሁና፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር እናንተን በደስታና በሐሤት ለዘለዓለም ይመልስልኛል።
የጽዮን ጎረቤቶች መማረካችሁን እንዳዩ፥ እንዲሁም በታላቅ ክብርና በዘለዓለማዊው አምላክ ብርሃን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የምትመጣላችሁን ድኅነታችሁን ፈጥነው ያያሉ።

Children! Receive with patience the wrath that has come upon you from the Lord; your adversaries have troubled you, and you shall see their downfall swiftly; you shall rise against them by your own strength.
The righteous have walked in the way of their God; and the adversaries have been scattered like chaff before the wind.
Children! Be strong; and cry out to God; He who has called you will remember you.
As you have been faithful to the Lord, so shall you seek Him ten times more and return to Him with all your heart.
He who has brought you this message shall bring you everlasting joy along with your poverty.

sections.title: The deliverance of Jerusalem is as it has been established.

verses.text: O Jerusalem, be strong; He who calls your name shall strengthen you.
Your affliction shall be a source of joy to those who mock you in your downfall.
Your children, whom you have sold, and those cities that have taken your children captive shall mock you.
In your destruction, joy shall be like a feast; in your downfall, laughter shall be as if it were made for you, thus you shall be consumed by your own ruin.
I shall remove much of her joy from her; her joy shall return to sorrow.
Fire shall come from the eternal God and shall burn for a long time, and for many ages it shall be a dwelling place of torment.
Jerusalem, look to the east; behold the joy that comes from your God, the Lord.
Behold, your children whom you sent away have returned; they have gathered from the east and the west by the holy word, and in the glory of the Lord, they shall rejoice.
O Jerusalem! Cast off thy garments of sorrow and affliction; and put on thy beautiful garments, which thou hast received from the Lord thy God for everlasting glory.
From the Lord, take refuge in thy righteousness; let the glory of the eternal God be upon thy head.
The Lord hath revealed thy light unto all that are beneath the heavens.
Thy name shall be called in the Lord a peace of righteousness for eternity, and the honor of the Lord shall be called upon thee.

O Jerusalem! Arise, stand upon the high places; and look toward the east; for thy children shall be gathered together from the west and from the east, as they are called by the holy word; and they shall rejoice in the remembrance of the Lord.
And from thee shall they come forth; their enemies shall be subdued; but the Lord shall bring them unto thee, as a king is borne upon a throne in glory.

And the Lord shall make low every mountain and hill, and every valley shall be filled; and the earth shall be made straight; and Israel shall walk in the glory of the Lord upon the highway that is prepared.
Israel shall be as a tree planted by the command of the Lord, and every good tree shall bear fruit.
The Lord shall bring Israel with joy, in the brightness of His glory, in His mercy, and He shall bring them forth in righteousness.
